name: templateyt
title: Ticket Templates
description: Ticket and article templates that set content and fields, are applied on conditions or on demand, and can be hierarchical.
changeNotes:
Version 0.2.0:
- Templates can set ticket fields, either to fixed values or to values chosen by the user when applying.
- Templates can add tags to tickets and articles.
- Text replacements: replace placeholder words with text entered by the user or with a root ticket field value.
- Hierarchical templates create subtasks (or sub-articles) from the template article's child articles, with conditional child templates, field inheritance and relations.
- Set fields fills in user-chosen fields of templates added automatically.
- Reworked configuration page: grouped sections, all validation errors at once, list filter, duplicate template, unsaved-changes warning.
- Reworked Apply template dialog: shows what each template does, only relevant actions, confirmation on remove and notifications after each action.
- The dialog asks for empty fields that text replacements need, remembers entered texts, and lets users change the fields that decide conditional subtasks.
- Requires YouTrack 2024.4.0 or later.
